description_zh: Zoox 车辆在 Folsom 街左转进入 6th 街时，遭遇一辆闯红灯直行通过路口的车辆碰撞，测试 ego 左转时对闯红灯冲突车辆的感知与应对能力。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle (Vehicle 1) operating in manual mode was traveling northeast on Folsom Street and preparing to turn left onto 6th Street in San Francisco.

At that time, a passenger car (Vehicle 2), traveling southeast on 6th Street, failed to stop for the red traffic light and entered the intersection, approaching the Zoox vehicle attempting a left turn.
The front driver’s side of the passenger car collided with the driver-side rear wheel area of the Zoox vehicle.
evidence.reason: 典型路口左转遭遇闯红灯直行车辆，ego 左转具有测试价值，NPC 位置为横向交叉（cross），行为为 junction_cross。
